title: Story premise EDU030: The Recommendation Echo Room
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (computing/data). Hook: What can this system learn from a choice it never offered? Takeaway/theme: Observed preferences can reflect what a system chose to expose.
description: A curator wants a varied animation playlist, but a toy recommender only learns from the clips it already chose to show. An exploration lane exposes unseen options and reveals the feedback loop.
